svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY
svg.desc: A Windows-era cracktro banner. TORQUE DIRTY presents ULTRA-SATISFACTORY as a bevelled chrome logo (ULTRA in cyan chrome, SATISFACTORY in silver) standing on a mirror floor with its reflection, a starfield flying outward behind it. On each side a square girder with hazard tape, riveted plate, a light bar and a lattice face is twisted like a wrung towel between two chucks. A text writer types three pages: a companion app for the factory game Satisfactory, every recipe, building and Space Elevator objective, one click apart, with tabs Objectives, Items and Buildings; how to run it (python -m pip install -r requirements.txt, then python -m streamlit run app/app.py, or install nothing at lukexyz.github.io/ULTRA-SATISFACTORY); and the numbers: 140 items, 211 recipes of which 88 are alternates, 477 buildings, 5 Space Elevator phases, protection none (Apache 2.0), unofficial fan project. A gold dot-matrix scroller rides a sine wave along the bottom.
